## Product Identification

Muscemor is 5-Cyclopentadecen-1-one, 3-methyl (also known as 3-methylcyclopentadecenone) with the chemical formula C16H28O and CAS number 63314-79-4. It is used in fine fragrance formulas.

## Hazard Information

Muscemor may cause an allergic skin reaction, and it is very toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects.

## Safety Precautions

Users should avoid breathing dust/fume/gas/mist/vapours/spray and avoid release to the environment. Protective gloves should be worn.

The complete safety data sheet is available from International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF), the product supplier. If you need more detailed information, you can access the full SDS document linked in the search results.

## Overview
Muscemor (also known as Muscenone) is a macrocyclic ketone musk developed by IFF, renowned for its high strength, long-lasting presence, and refined nitro-musk character.

## Chemical Properties
The chemical formula is C16 H28 O with a molecular weight of 236.39, and it appears as a clear mobile liquid that is colorless to pale yellow with a musk, musk ketone type, animal odor.

## Applications
Used at very low levels as a fragrance enhancer, and at higher dosages as a primary musky note, Muscemor delivers a naturalistic, slightly animalic softness with powdery and woody facets. It exhibits extraordinary substantivity on fabric, skin, and hair and is widely utilized in luxury compositions, including Bulgari for Men.

## Storage
It should be kept in a tightly closed container in a cool and dry place, protected from light.

This compound is a popular ingredient in the fragrance industry due to its powerful musk character and versatility in perfume formulations.
